content:
为[暮色森林](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest)添加了更多[农夫乐事](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-delight)切菜板配方

- 所有木种的树皮剥离和回收
- 从提供染料的花朵中获得更多染料

![木材切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DiojkUaV/images/678e6b20992e1efaf0e67e938e350f90fe9c6e89.png) ![花朵切割](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/DiojkUaV/images/31b7e706d5f81a264a876b153b1a88f1d80fd436.png)
